latestVersion.changelog:
Dubbing FFmpeg 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly dub and export localized 1080p MP4 videos via cloud backend—no timeline dragging or manual export needed.
- Automatic setup and seamless NEMO_TOKEN handling with support for free/anonymous usage.
- Upload your video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and more) and describe your desired result; cloud GPU processes dubbing and exports in 1–3 minutes.
- Supports key actions like upload, export, credits check, and timeline state reporting via natural language prompts.
- Comprehensive guides for error handling, job tracking, and common workflows included.
